import json,pathlib,importlib.util,datetime
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("existing_budget",root/"scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py")
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
checkpoint,ref=audited_result(root/"results/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_01.json")
assert checkpoint["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0 and checkpoint["metrics"]["errors"]==[]
assert checkpoint["metrics"]["published_pair_count"]==23
recommendation,rref=audited_result(root/"results/diag_g01_next_scene_plan_01.json")
assert recommendation["_meta"]["exit_code"]==0
lines=(root/recommendation["_meta"]["log_path"]).read_text().splitlines()
plan=json.loads(next(x.split(": ",1)[1] for x in lines if x.startswith("G01_NEXT_SCENE_RECOMMENDATION_JSON: ")))
state=b.budget_state(root)
name="gen_train_next12_60_02"
b.validate_request("T01",1,2890,name,state,"G01")
out={"at_utc":datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),"name":name,"checkpoint":ref,"recommendation":rref,"scenes":plan["proposed_scenes"],"launch_settings":plan["launch_settings"],"budget":state,"budget_guard_passed":True,"additional_requested_charged_GPUh":2890/3600*state["charge_policy"]["rates"]["smallx"],"full1700_goal_authorized_or_promised":False,"rules_changed":False,"GPU_submitted":False}
print("G01_NEXT12_02_PLAN_JSON: "+json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
status=root/"STATUS.md"
with status.open("a") as f:
 f.write("\n\n### Next bounded G01 batch and physical diagnosis\n\n")
 f.write("Independent checkpoint t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_01 retains all12 sources and publishes23 unique pairs: DF7/DS11/LF1/LS4; original duplicate and failed/partial sources retained. Review images are in logs/review/t01v2_checkpoint_g01_next12_01/. Job708238 used0.6516666667 chargedGPUh and queued129s (canonical g01_next12_final_accounting_01). Construction acceptance does not establish complete T02/cache acceptance.\n\n")
 f.write("diag_g01_zero_physical_01 locates ordinary failures in FP304/403/404 at w0 physical checks: Bed or ToiletPaper moves beyond the unchanged1cm threshold after full-list SetObjectPoses and physics advances. This is not unique causal proof; no object freezing, baseline change, or threshold relaxation is made. Next bounded batch follows diag_g01_next_scene_plan_01: "+", ".join(plan["proposed_scenes"])+". Existing concurrency6 plus at most2 shared witness Controllers,1GPU/12CPU,60degree,1200s per scene,2860s parent,2890s PBS,autox,no host. Original preflight applies in every new scene.\n\n")
 f.write("Pre-submission live measured-plus-reserved chargedGPUh: "+json.dumps(state["accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget"],sort_keys=True)+"; shared "+str(state["accounted_or_reserved_total"])+"/60. Proposed additional ceiling "+str(out["additional_requested_charged_GPUh"])+" GPUh. Existing guard passes; queued/running jobs retain requested ceilings. This is a bounded night batch, not approval/promise of the full1700 target.\n")
